responsibility: This header implements GCC’s generic Fibonacci heap template, including the fibonacci_node and fibonacci_heap classes. It owns heap node structure, pool-based node allocation, root-list and child-list manipulations, decrease/replace-key handling, extract-min consolidation, deletion by forcing the global minimum key, and heap union, providing an efficient meldable priority queue for compiler algorithms that need fast inserts, key decreases, and merges.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual fibonacci_node and fibonacci_heap template implementation, including insert, extract-min, key replacement, consolidation, and union. The same-stem .cc file is only a selftest driver for this header implementation.
